_comment: SHA-256 integrity manifest for ML models (security control H-08/H-12). Maps each model's path (relative to BULWARK_ML_MODEL_DIR) to its trusted SHA-256. The ONNX loader (src/scanners/ml/model_manager.py) fails closed if a load-bearing file is missing from this manifest or its hash does not match. Every model pins ALL load-bearing files, not just the weights: model.onnx (weights), tokenizer.json (a poisoned tokenizer can silently remap an attack payload to benign token ids) and config.json (drives id2label label ordering — a silent reorder inverts every verdict for NLI-style models). Regenerate/verify with: python scripts/download-models.py --all  /  --verify
